spans.s:
nandana, a. gladdening; causing joy; as
m. son, 21^17; as n. Nandana, or Elysium,
the pleasure ground of the gods, esp. of
Indra, 49^18. [caus. of √nand.]

nandi, m. The Gladsome One, euphemistic
epithet of the dreadful god, ŚivaRudra.
 [√nand: cf. śiva.]

nandi-deva, m. Nandideva, name of a
Brahman. [‘having Śiva as his god.’]
